validation_sequence: All 12 original round-trip variants passed; the wrapper was edited while running and then hit a shell syntax error after those cases. Corrected wrapper passes bash -n.
Final normal and reduced paths include the additional 19-check private seat handoff and inspection flow. Concession and tie paths also passed.
All five existing sandbox runs and a general table camera/input probe passed.
After integrating new main #269, rebuilt and published v6 art, reran all 519 deterministic checks, zero-warning client/normal launcher, and final normal/tie native round trips.
issues_found_and_resolved: Suppressed champion introductions at the external entrance.
Duplicate outgoing card copies during return.
Repeated generic battle casualty after an already-presented duel result.
Native fixed-FPS harness did not allow macOS focus events to settle; live match probes use real-time rendering.
Fresh headless editor import crashed; native import completed and subsequent headless import passed.
A check invocation picked Apple Python 3.9; reran with the project-compatible Homebrew Python.
Newly merged #269 added two scans; complete version-pinned v6 pack restores strict launcher coverage.
limits: Source/native Mac evidence; no new Windows graphical playtest or human cross-platform private match.
Two-client WebSocket integration is automated; no internet server deployed.
Fixed-FPS sandbox timing samples are not a performance benchmark or AAA equivalence claim.
Mendon mechanical/shared review and required CI remain merge gates.
Large inherited PR diff prevents automatic file-list review routing; request the reviewer directly.
